title: Repeated Changes Charged on One Vacation Package
content:
A party that has already been charged for changing a package sold under Wanderlane's Vacation Package Products is charged more for changing it again. What the package ledger already carries decides the multiple, and the lines that count are those charged as an amendment, as a name change and as a date change on that same package.

**Where the package ledger already carries two or more such lines** — 2 or more of them standing together — the sum of the starting amount and anything added to it is taken at twice its value instead of once: a multiple of 2 applied to that sum.

**Where the package ledger already carries exactly one such line** — exactly 1 — that sum is taken at one and a half times its value instead of once: the sum together with a further 50 per cent of it.

**Where the package ledger carries no such line at all**, no multiple of that kind is taken on the sum.

## The count and the multiple

| Lines on the package ledger charged as an amendment, a name change or a date change | The sum is taken at |
| --- | --- |
| 2 or more | twice its value |
| exactly 1 | one and a half times its value |
| none | no multiple of this kind |

## Worked on hypothetical particulars

Where the starting amount is 120.00 USD and 75.00 USD has been added to it, the sum is 195.00 USD. With 2 such lines already on the package ledger, the sum is taken at twice its value, being 390.00 USD. With exactly 1 such line, it is taken at one and a half times its value, being 292.50 USD, that is 195.00 USD together with a further 50 per cent of it. With no such line, the sum of 195.00 USD stands.
